user.title: FERMAX Connection Credentials
user.description: Enter your FERMAX DuoxMe account credentials and the OAuth details from the mobile app. For more details on how to obtain these, please see the [documentation]({docs_link}).

fcm.title: Push Notification Credentials (FCM)
fcm.description: Enter the Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) credentials. These are required to receive real-time notifications from your doorbell, and a core part of this integration. For a detailed guide, see the [documentation]({docs_link}).

init.title: FERMAX DuoxMe Options

data.enable_live_snapshot: Capture live image from the call video (WebRTC)

init.description: Enable this to listen for real-time events from FERMAX's servers. This provides instant ring notifications with live snapshots from your doorbell. If disabled, only the door lock entity will be available. If live image capture is disabled, the latest photo stored by FERMAX is used instead (avoids installing aiortc). The capture method picks who receives the call video: go2rtc (built into Home Assistant) or aiortc. Choose an automatic door-lock duration from 1 to 30 seconds; existing setups keep the 2-second default.

options.aiortc: aiortc (Python library, installed on first use)
